description: Fix codexSandboxArgs so `codex exec` non-bypass branch uses `-c approval_policy=never` instead of the exec-rejected `--ask-for-approval never`, unblocking the codex reviewer pane.

userStories.title: Render codex exec approval policy via -c approval_policy=never
userStories.description: As a codex-backed worker/reviewer, I need CodexAdapter's non-bypass sandbox args to use only flags `codex exec` accepts so my pane starts and emits a <review> verdict instead of dying at argv-parse and circuit-breaking the supervisor.
acceptanceCriteria: codexSandboxArgs for a non-bypass permissionMode (e.g. 'acceptEdits') renders a string containing '--sandbox workspace-write' AND '-c approval_policy=never' AND NOT containing '--ask-for-approval'. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts]

codexSandboxArgs for permissionMode 'bypassPermissions' still renders '--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox' and contains none of '--sandbox', '--ask-for-approval', or 'approval_policy'. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts]

A contract test enumerates codex exec's accepted flag surface (codex-cli 0.144.6: -s/--sandbox, -c/--config, -m/--model, --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox, -C/--cd, -p/--profile, -i/--image, --output-schema, --json, -o/--output-last-message, --color, --ephemeral, --oss) and asserts the rendered CodexAdapter `codex exec` argv for every worker actor uses only accepted flags, in particular never '--ask-for-approval'; the test fails if an exec-rejected flag is re-introduced, and it does NOT shell out to a real codex binary. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts]

The header doc comment on codexSandboxArgs (src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts ~L346-362) describes the '-c approval_policy=never' rendering and no longer claims a '--ask-for-approval never' rendering. [oracle: ! grep -q 'ask-for-approval' src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
The full quality spine is green after the change. [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts (codexSandboxArgs non-bypass branch L367: replace '--ask-for-approval never' fragment with '-c approval_policy=never', keep '--sandbox workspace-write'; leave bypass branch '--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox' unchanged; rewrite the L346-362 header doc comment in the SAME edit, doc-maintenance). test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts: flip the non-bypass shape assertion (~L54-63) from toContain('--ask-for-approval never') to toContain('-c approval_policy=never') + not.toContain('--ask-for-approval'); keep the bypass-branch L50 not.toContain('--ask-for-approval'); add the new contract test that asserts the argv string against the documented accepted-flag surface. Verified live (codex-cli 0.144.6): `codex exec --sandbox workspace-write -c approval_policy=never ...` parses (session header: 'approval: never / sandbox: workspace-write'); '--ask-for-approval' is a TOP-LEVEL codex flag, NOT an exec-subcommand flag, so exec rejects it at clap parse. Do NOT invoke real codex in the suite: CI (macos-latest) has no codex binary or auth. Gotcha: backend-adapter.ts is sidecar-executed; a coherence rebuild (bash scripts/build-release.sh --install + restart sidecar by pid) is required after this ships, but that is an operator post-merge step, not part of this story. Root cause: CAM-350 tests asserted argv SHAPE only, never that codex accepts it (shape-vs-semantics gap).
